beats.label: hook
beats.text: A girl from rural Mississippi discovers she can literally unravel the dark folklore haunting her bayou — and every chapter plays to its own original blues song.

beats.label: gameplay
beats.text: You're Hazel. A hurricane floods your town and tears your house apart — but it also awakens a weaving magic that lets you fight the Haints: supernatural creatures from deep American South folklore. Use weaving abilities to battle folk monsters, heal the land, and explore a flooded Southern Gothic world built on real mythology and music.

beats.label: standout
beats.text: Compulsion Games built South of Midnight with a stop-motion-inspired visual style unlike anything else on the market, and an original blues and folk soundtrack composed specifically for the game. One of the most distinctive Xbox studio projects in years — and it's now on PS5 and Switch 2 too.

beats.label: cta
beats.text: South of Midnight is available now on Xbox, PC via Game Pass, PS5, and Switch 2.
